constraints.name: finance_combined_document_audit_event_combined_document_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (combined_document_id) REFERENCES finance_combined_documents(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: combined_audit_history
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX combined_audit_history ON public.finance_combined_document_audit_events USING btree (combined_document_id, created_at)

indexes.name: finance_combined_document_audit_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_combined_document_audit_events_pkey ON public.finance_combined_document_audit_events USING btree (id)

constraints.name: combined_lifecycle
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (combined_no IS NULL) AND (issued_at IS NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'issued'::text) AND (combined_no IS NOT NULL) AND (combined_no ~ '^VP-RTI-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$'::text) AND (issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(issued_snapshot_json) = 'object'::text))))

constraints.name: finance_combined_documents_payment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES finance_payments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: finance_combined_documents_receipt_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (receipt_id) REFERENCES finance_receipts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_combined_documents_tax_invoice_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tax_invoice_id) REFERENCES finance_tax_invoices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX combined_active_payment ON public.finance_combined_documents USING btree (payment_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'issued'::text]))

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_combined_documents_tax_invoice_id_key ON public.finance_combined_documents USING btree (tax_invoice_id)

constraints.name: finance_receipts_combined_document_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (combined_document_id) REFERENCES finance_combined_documents(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_receipts_lifecycle_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (receipt_no IS NULL) AND (issued_at IS NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['issued'::text, 'voided'::text])) AND (receipt_no IS NOT NULL) AND (((combined_document_id IS NULL) AND (receipt_no ~ '^VP-RC-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$'::text)) OR ((combined_document_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'issued'::text) AND (receipt_no ~ '^VP-RTI-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$'::text))) AND (issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(issued_snapshot_json) = 'object'::text) AND (issued_snapshot_json <> '{}'::jsonb))))

indexes.name: finance_receipts_combined_document_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_receipts_combined_document_id_key ON public.finance_receipts USING btree (combined_document_id)

constraints.name: finance_tax_invoices_combined_document_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (combined_document_id) REFERENCES finance_combined_documents(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: tax_invoice_lifecycle
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (tax_invoice_no IS NULL) AND (issued_at IS NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'issued'::text) AND (tax_invoice_no IS NOT NULL) AND (((combined_document_id IS NULL) AND (tax_invoice_no ~ '^VP-TI-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$'::text)) OR ((combined_document_id IS NOT NULL) AND (tax_invoice_no ~ '^VP-RTI-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$'::text))) AND (issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (issued_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(issued_snapshot_json) = 'object'::text))))

indexes.name: finance_tax_invoices_combined_document_id_key
